items: [State] the state holds tokens and the time of the last refill, with a sub-token remainder (fixed point or equivalent)
[try_take] refill happens first, from elapsed time, before the admission decision
[try_take] refill is integer arithmetic and keeps the fractional remainder between calls
[try_take] all or nothing: a refused request consumes no tokens
[Edge cases] `n == 0` is granted without changing state, even with a backwards clock
[Edge cases] a backwards `now_ms` refills nothing and does not move the refill time back or underflow
[Edge cases] long idle periods do not overflow the refill arithmetic
